400 Bad Request

The request parameters are invalid or missing. 
Usage:

https://affiliate.linkwi.se/api/1.1/programs.html?<parameter_name>=<parameter_value>

required parameters:

joined               Filter results according to the program's status.
                     Can be either all / no / yes
                     
optional parameters:

format               Can be either xml or json

keyword              Only show programs with names that contain this string

program_ids          Only show programs with these ids
                     Please specify a list of program ids, separated by
                     commas.

scope                Can be either contains or begins.
                     For use with the "keyword" parameter.

has_datafeed         1 to enable, 0 to disable

categories           Only show programs belonging to specific categories.
                     Please specify a list of category names (or IDs), separated by
                     commas.

parent_categories    Only show programs belonging to specific parent categories.
                     Please specify a list of category IDS, separated by
                     commas.

types                Filter programs according to their payout category types.
                     Can be either sale,lead,click.
                     You can specify more than one values, separated with commas

countries            Filter programs according to their country.
                     Please specify a list of country names(e.g. greece) or country_codes(e.g. gr), separated by commas.
                
lang                 If you specify "gr" or "eng" with this parameter, all applicable
                     program information will be translated to the specified language.
                
status               Filter results according to the program\'s status.
                     Can be active or inactive or all. Default value is active.

Example: https://affiliate.linkwi.se/api/1.1/programs.html?joined=yes&countries=Greece

Currency fields are strings to avoid rounding errors on large values

Global options:

timezone    Can be either "UTC" (the default) or "Europe/Athens"

rest_date_format    All dates use the ISO 8601 format by default
                    (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601). You can change this
                    by setting this option to "timestamp".

rest_json_force_object  If you use the JSON format, set this option to "on" to
                        force the response to be enclosed into an object.

rest_jsonp_callback   If you use the JSON format, set this option to callback function's name to
                      force the response to be enclosed into a function call. It must be a valid
                      function name.
